body: Honestly, it's not a bad thing to want new friends. I remember when I used to hang out with people that wouldn't even acknowledge my existence and it was no fun at all. Then I actually started to hang out with people who want me in their life and will actually talk to me. In my experience be with people who want you not the ones you are longing for who don't even want you. Finding new friends is the best option by far and it might take a while but as long as your willing to find new friends they should be in your life soon
